contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

domains.description: One entry per vertical the engine declares capability for (unique verticals — invariant duplicate_profile_vertical). Phase 1: the building vertical only.

domain.description: The vertical this capability entry covers (building in Phase 1; future verticals are addable by the engine without contract changes).

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

extensions.description: Vertical-specific extension descriptors, carried as DATA — never interpreted, enforced or extended by a client.

kind.description: Extension kind (open vocabulary, e.g. building-element-taxonomy, assembly-compatibility-rules).

ref.description: Stable reference to the extension definition (vocabulary or ruleset id).

version.description: Semver version of the extension definition this descriptor pins.

operationVocabulary.description: Identifier of the operation-type vocabulary the solution's operations use (e.g. aise-building-operations-v1). Identifies which engine-owned catalogue the open operationType strings belong to.

vertical.description: The engineering vertical of the solution's operations (OPEN vocabulary; Phase 1 advisory value: building. Documented future verticals: civil-works, mep, industrial-equipment, electronics, integrated-circuits). Rendered verbatim by clients; vertical semantics are owned by the server solution engine.

operations.description: The per-operation-type capability entries (unique operation types — invariant duplicate_operation_type_capability).

limitations.description: Material limitations of this operation type on this engine right now (rendered before any consequential action).

operationType.description: The operation type this entry declares capability for (the ENGINE's vocabulary; open string, e.g. the BUILDING_OPERATION_TYPES values).

requiredParameters.description: Parameter names the engine requires to execute this operation type (missing ones negotiate to `blocked`, driving the agent's clarification questions — never invented values).

status.description: supported | unavailable | degraded | unknown. `unknown` = not yet determined; never equivalent to `unavailable`.
Domain-level status. `unknown` is never conflated with `unavailable` (an undetermined domain negotiates to `unknown`, not `unsupported`).

engineKind.description: The deterministic solution engine declaring this profile (e.g. aise-solution-engine).

profileId.description: Stable id of this capability profile.

updatedAt.description: Instant the engine produced this profile snapshot.
